task: Change the woman's hair to red
title: 窗边持杯：头发改红
prompt:
subject_definitions:
<Video 1> is the source video for this local video edit, providing the original camera framing, shot structure, visible action sequence, pacing and duration.
<Subject 1> is the blonde woman holding a light-colored cup beside the window in <Video 1>. Her identity, hairstyle shape, visible hand motion and gaze come from the source; only her hair color becomes red.
<Subject 2> is the original cup, window, background, clothing and unedited scene content in <Video 1>.
Source context: A woman with long blonde hair is holding a cup and smiling while looking out of a window.

summary:
[video editing] The target video is an edited version of <Video 1>. Change the woman’s hair color to red, preserving her identity, cup-lowering performance and the original scene colors.
Requested edit: Change the woman's hair to red

retention_analysis:
<Subject 1> (appears in [Shot 1]): partially_preserved - apply the requested edit. Change only the hair color from blonde to red. Preserve the same woman, facial features, hairstyle shape, smile, gaze, body pose and complete hand and cup-lowering motion.
<Subject 2> (appears in [Shot 1]): fully_preserved - preserve the original cup, window, clothing, background, lighting and all colors outside the edited hair, with their source positions and interactions.
<Video 1> (cut and pacing structure): fully_preserved - preserve the original camera framing and movement, shot continuity, visible action order, timing and duration.
The requested edit defines the appearance change. The visible subject definitions and unchanged source content govern scene details.

detailed_description:
The target video retains the photographic appearance, lighting and camera composition of <Video 1>.
[Shot 1] The same woman with red hair holds the original light-colored cup by the window. Her smiling, turning gaze and gradual cup-lowering motion follow <Video 1>. The original photographic lighting, background and unedited colors remain throughout.
The complete visible action sequence and all its phases follow <Video 1> in their original order and timing.
